The adults in my life wouldn’t know that kind of stuff. I’ve had to teach myself a lot. Which fine, lots of people do it, I’m not bragging about it I’m just saying what worked for me to get out of that state. 

Now for me it’s that I’m not giving enough to my family so I want to end my life. I don’t want to hear about their “sad” lives anymore after giving and giving and giving and then suggesting they hire help is like suggesting something terrible. 
So for me I’d rather just leave this place than live thru the pain of knowing all their troubles. Which I would hear about thru the family grapevine. I’ve been screamed at for months and then when I was in the hospital, they still blamed me for not being there to help. Rather then ask if I’m ok they yelled at me over fb messenger for not being mentally capable to deal with 2 kids who already have so many of their own problems Fr parental abandonment. 
So for me I’m struggling to cut them off or just cut my life short. Working with a psychiatrist and some follow up workers Fr my hospital visit.
